items.title: Give every Daily Rite route segment a visible stake, risk, and consequence ledger
items.why: The current Daily Rite room weave already consumes Director segments, but it mostly explains rooms one beat at a time. A route-level stakes ledger turns the run into a strategic myth contract before the first wave and makes every death, clear, and share feel authored by the sun rather than by a generic dungeon.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic `dailyRiteStakes` module, attach its summary to `createDailyRiteRun`, export it in public chronicle/status, and cover the contract in tests.

items.title: Turn local feedback events into a zero-token action attribution loop
items.why: Solara now records public-safe local events, but the digest only counts broad categories. Adding action/source attribution lets the game learn which guidance actually moves a player without collecting private payloads or paying for inference.
items.recipe: Extend `feedbackLedger` events and summaries with sanitized `action_id` and `source`, then add tests proving privacy, caps, and next-action aggregation remain zero-token.

items.title: Make the PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA gate impossible to misread in public status
items.why: The repo has converged on the right project-scoped database gate, but public integration surfaces still compress readiness into prose. A structured runbook block can distinguish missing secret, workflow not run, RPC not hardened, and live-ready states without leaking credentials.
items.recipe: Expand `buildBackendReadiness` with `blocked_by`, `verification_command`, `workflow`, and `scale_posture`, then surface those fields in generated status and tests.

items.title: Add local compatibility shims for missing Studio protocol scripts observed during /start
items.why: This session hit missing `skill-profile`, `credential-watch`, `ark`, and brief-staleness scripts before reaching the validated brief. Lightweight no-op shims keep public repos aligned with the Studio command surface while preserving the public/private boundary.
items.recipe: Add safe local scripts that return explicit no-op JSON/status for absent private overlays, credential watch, Ark drain, and brief freshness.

items.title: Extract the Daily Rite sidebar status into a focused component
items.why: `src/App.jsx` remains the biggest drag on iteration, and the Daily Rite panel is now dense with run, vow, challenge, pacing, and share logic. Extracting the display surface creates a smaller future edit target without changing the run loop.
items.recipe: Move the read-only Daily Rite status display into `src/components/DailyRiteStatus.jsx` and keep copy/share handlers in `App.jsx` until a later interaction extraction.

skipped.reason: Rejected because Solara's standing decision keeps browser and default runtime token cost at zero.
Rejected because the 2026-06-07 decision requires project-scoped `PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA`, not a generic shared database credential.

executionLog.evidence: Added explicit no-op shims for skill-profile, credential-watch, Ark drain, and brief staleness; startup brief render and validation pass.
Backend readiness now exports blocked_by, verification_command, workflow, and scale_posture; chronicle tests pin PG_CONNECTION_SOLARA.
Feedback ledger stores sanitized action/source labels and aggregate attribution with token_cost 0; unit tests cover privacy and chronicle export.
New dailyRiteStakes module is attached to Daily Rite runs and exported through chronicle/status; tests cover token_cost 0 and segment coverage.
Daily Rite sidebar display moved into src/components/DailyRiteStatus.jsx; build and smoke pass with the new component stubbed in the Node harness.
